metadata.description: Agent plugins for Microsoft Power Platform, Dataverse and Dynamics 365 delivery: Dataverse POC orchestration and a code-first project wiki.

plugins.name: dataverse-poc
plugins.description: Multi-agent Dataverse POC: an orchestrator plans (model-driven or code app), opens stages with user confirmation and delegates to hidden sub-agents for HTML/YAML prototype, data model, demo data, forms/views/sitemap, generative pages, PCF, web resources, code app, tests and deploy. Includes a PreToolUse guard on PAC/PACX commands.

plugins.name: power-platform-llm-wiki
plugins.description: Code-first project knowledge base for Dynamics 365 delivery — single agent with five skills (init, config, update, ingest, query). Analyses code (Azure Repos, GitHub, local), Dataverse and F&O metadata, work items, meetings, FDD/TDD; publishes to Azure DevOps Wiki or GitHub Wiki.
